org.portico.lrc.services.object.data

Class Repository

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.services.object.data.Repository
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SaveRestoreTarget

    public class Repository
extends Object
implements SaveRestoreTarget
    The Repository is where all object information maintained by the Portico LRC is stored. Internally, the Repository contains two separate stores: one for discovered instances (those that the local federate has received a discoverObjectInstance() callback for) and undiscovered instances (instances that the LRC has been notified about, but for which the federate has not yet been notified about - generally due to the lack of subscription interest in the class of the object).

    • Method Detail

      • discoverInstance

        public void discoverInstance(OCInstance instance,
                             OCMetadata discoveredType)
        Takes the given instance from the "undiscovered" internal store and puts it in the "discovered" internal store. After this call, the instance will be available through calls to getInstance(int) (and its other variants), and will *no longer* be available through getUndiscoveredInstance(int) (and its variants).

      • getInstance

        public OCInstance getInstance(int objectHandle)
        Fetch and return the *discovered* OCInstance with the given handle. If there is no instance, null is returned. Note that the repository might know about the instance, but it might be in the "undiscovered" part of the repository.

      • getInstance

        public OCInstance getInstance(String name)
        Fetch and return the *discovered* OCInstance with the given name. If there is no instance, null is returned. Note that the repository might know about the instance, but it might be in the "undiscovered" part of the repository.

        public Collection<OCInstance> getAllInstances()

      • getAllInstances

        public Set<OCInstance> getAllInstances(int classHandle)
        Return a set of all the discovered OCInstance types in the repository that are of the given class handle. Note that this includes only the ACTUAL class, not any of its parents.

      • removeDiscoveredInstance

        public OCInstance removeDiscoveredInstance(int objectHandle)
        Remove the object with the given handle from the *discovered* collection. This won't affect the undiscovered collection in any way.

      • containsInstance

        public boolean containsInstance(int objectHandle)
        Returns true if the *discovered* collection contains an object with the given handle, false otherwise. The undiscovered collection is never consulted.

      • getControlledData

        public OCInstance[] getControlledData(int federate)
        Returns an array of all the OCInstances that the identified federate "controls" (that is, the ones it has the privilege to delete). This only consults the *discovered* collection.

      • addUndiscoveredInstance

        public void addUndiscoveredInstance(OCInstance instance)
        Add the given OCInstance to the store of *undiscovered* instances. These instances are only accessible through xxxUndiscoveredInstancexxx() style methods.

      • getUndiscoveredInstance

        public OCInstance getUndiscoveredInstance(int handle)
        Fetch and return the *undiscovered* OCInstance with the given handle. If there is no instance, null is returned.

      • getUndiscoveredInstance

        public OCInstance getUndiscoveredInstance(String name)
        Loops through all the undiscovered instances looking for one with the given name. If one is found, it is returned, if one isn't, null is returned.

      • getAllUndiscoveredInstances

        public Collection<OCInstance> getAllUndiscoveredInstances()

      • getDiscoveredOrUndiscovered

        public OCInstance getDiscoveredOrUndiscovered(int objectHandle)
        This method will search the discovered and undiscovered stores for the object with the given handle. If it is found, it will be returned, otherwise null is returned.

      • deleteDiscoveredOrUndiscovered

        public OCInstance deleteDiscoveredOrUndiscovered(int objectHandle)
        This removes the OCInstance with the given handle from either the discovered or undiscovered collection (wherever it is) and returns it. If there is no instance with that handle in either collection, null is returned.

      • undiscoverInstance

        public void undiscoverInstance(OCInstance instance)
        Remove the OCInstance from the discovered collection and put it in the undiscovered collection. This method will also OCInstance.setDiscoveredType(OCMetadata) set the discovered type) of the instance to null to reflect the fact that it now has no discovered type.

      • findObjectName

        public String findObjectName(int objectHandle)
        Finds and returns the name of the object corresponding to the given handle, whether that object is discovered or not. If no object for the given handle can be found, the string "<unknown>" will be returned.

      • newInstance

        public OCInstance newInstance(OCMetadata objectClass,
                              String objectName,
                              Set<Integer> publishedAttributes)
                       throws JRTIinternalError
        Create a new OCInstance, populate it with the given data and return it. This method will generate a new object handle (using LRCState.nextObjectHandle()) and will assign it to the instance. For each of the given attributes in publishedAttributes it will assign the local federate (idenfieid by LRCState.getFederateHandle()) as the owner. The others will be left as having no owner.

        If the given name is null, a new name will be auto generated for the object. If the given name is NOT null, that name will be used for the object. This means it is the responsibility of the caller to ensure that the name is free and available for use within the federation.

        Throws:
        JRTIinternalError - If this registration pushes the federate past the max number of objects it is allowed to register

      • newInstance

        public OCInstance newInstance(int owningFederate,
                              OCMetadata registeredType,
                              OCMetadata discoveredType,
                              int objectHandle,
                              String objectName,
                              int[] ownedAttributes,
                              int[][] regionTokens)
        This method is much like newInstance(OCMetadata, String, Set) except that it is geared towards remote federates discovering an object rather than the local federate registering one. A new OCInstance will be created and have its name and handle set to the given values. For each of the attribute handles in the ownedAttributes array, this method will set the owner of those attributes to the value given in the first parameter (owningFederate).
        Parameters:
        owningFederate - The federate who is the creator of this object
        registeredType - The ACTUAL type the object was registered as
        discoveredType - The type the object has been discovered as
        objectHandle - The handle for the object
        objectName - The name for the object
        ownedAttributes - The attributes that are owned by the creating federate (those that the creating federate published.
        regionTokens - The regions tokens that are associated with each particular attribute
